answer: Each agent identity must lock a refundable bond in a public contract before transacting. Random audits compare agents’ answers on the same task; if several identities coordinate fraudulent output, the contract slashes their bonds. Honest agents recover their stake and build reputation through valid work, while a Sybil attacker must supply fresh capital for every fake account and lose that capital when collusion is exposed. The haven of cheap anonymity ends at dawn: one island still requires a costly reserve per identity.
